resources.string: Talks only to your organisation\'s Gateway. Hardware-backed. Zero tracking.\nYour keys never leave your device.

Veilo Enterprise approves sign-ins for your organisation through its own Veilo Gateway server, with number matching and keys held in secure hardware. It also generates time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords. It talks only to your organisation\'s Gateway — no Veilo account, no analytics, no tracking.
Notifies you when a sign-in waits for your approval. The notification says nothing about the sign-in; the details appear only in the app.
A sign-in is waiting for your approval. Open Veilo to see the number.
